en:
Eldest son of Kikkawa Kunitsune. A comrade-in-arms of Mouri Okimoto, Mouri Motonari's elder brother; the two fought side by side in campaigns across the land.
In the Siege of Kagamiyama Castle, he and Motonari set out to take Kagamiyama as the Amago vanguard. (Ep. 2)
In the Battle of Kanayama Castle, he again serves in the Amago vanguard and sets out with Kumagai Nobunao to relieve Kanayama Castle. But he is surrounded by an Ouchi ambush and falls into dire straits. (Ep. 4)

Eldest son of Kikkawa Kunitsune. A comrade-in-arms of Mouri Okimoto, Mouri Motonari's elder brother; the two fought side by side in campaigns across the land.

In the Battle of Kanayama Castle, he again serves in the Amago vanguard and sets out with Kumagai Nobunao to relieve Kanayama Castle. But he is surrounded by an Ouchi ambush and gravely wounded, and the wound costs him his life.
(Ep. 4)

Motonari's second son. His childhood name is Sho no Jiro. Brave and fiercely competitive, he makes a glorious battle debut in the Battle of Yoshida-Koriyama Castle.
It is decided that he will be adopted into the Kikkawa clan to carry on its line. (Ep. 9)

A Mouri retainer and the younger brother of the senior retainer Shiji Hiroyoshi. He leads the archers.

An Ouchi retainer and lord of Kagamiyama Castle. Together with his uncle Kurata Naonobu, he defends the castle and faces the Mouri and Kikkawa forces advancing on it as the Amago vanguard, but is betrayed by Naonobu. He fights hard, but in vain: the castle falls, and he takes his own life. (Ep. 2)
